tabs.tab_title: How is my moving quote calculated with Amar?
tabs.tab_content: Our quotes depend on the volume of goods, move distance, floor levels, elevator availability, and specialized packaging needs (such as crating for marble tops or high-end TVs). We conduct a 100% free doorstep survey to lock in a guaranteed quote with no surprise charges on moving day.

tabs.tab_title: Do you operate your own trucks or outsource to local tempos?
tabs.tab_content: Amar Packers operates its own fleet of 18+ GPS-monitored enclosed container trucks. We never outsource your precious belongings to freelance auto tempos or unverified sub-contractors.

tabs.tab_title: Are my belongings covered by transit insurance?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. We offer comprehensive transit and all-risk insurance coverage at up to 3% of the total declared consignment value. In the rare event of transit damage, our claims coordinator assists you with instant paperwork and claim settlement.

tabs.tab_title: How long does an intra-Mumbai home move take?
tabs.tab_content: Most 1 BHK and 2 BHK local Mumbai moves are completed on the same day within 5 to 8 hours. We pack in the morning, transport via the fastest available route, and unpack/reassemble at your new location by evening.

tabs.tab_title: Do you provide IBA-approved bills for corporate/bank reimbursement?
tabs.tab_content: Yes! We provide official 100% compliant documentation including IBA-format LR Bilty, GST itemized tax invoices with SAC 9965 code, and stamped money receipts widely accepted by government departments, PSUs, and banks.
